Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second half! The players make their way out to the middle. Liam Doherty and David Vincent will open the batting for Ireland Under-19. Rajvardhan Hangargekar will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Ireland Under-19 bowlers will be feeling a little bruised! A lot of spinners were used by Tim Tector, but the result remained the same. They were not very disciplined with their bowling through the innings. In the beginning, they missed their lines and lengths and allowed the Indian U-19 openers to score freely. They did manage to come back and pick up the wickets and fought well to restrict India Under-19 under 320 or even 330 which was looking quite achievable at one point. Jamie Forbes was excellent with the ball, he grabbed just one wicket, but was very economical in his spell. Muzamil Sherzad did not start off on the right note, but he did well to grab 3 wickets at the death, but again, he leaked 23 runs in his last over which ruined his entire spell. It's now upto the Irish batters, they have an uphill task here, but not an impossible one. Will Ireland Under-19 chase this down? Or will India Under-19 come out on top? We will find out soon.

India Under-19 got off to a flying start, Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Harnoor Singh put together 164 runs and were cruising away. Both of them might be disappointed about missing out on their centuries but without their sublime knock, India would not have reached a score of over 300. Raj Angad Bawa and Nishant Sindhu did add valuable runs on the board, but the cameo from Rajvardhan Hangargekar at the end guided their total to 307! The bowlers now have a task to defend the total. India Under-19 would be high on confidence coming into the second innings, considering they defended a much lower total in the previous game.

It was a decent recovery from Ireland Under-19 only until the last over! But however, the score would have looked a lot worse than 307 for Ireland Under-19. At one point India were looking to post a total of over 320 runs, but they have done well to restrict India for 307 runs. Still, a very healthy total on the board, and Ireland Under-19 do have a challenging task ahead of them.

FOUR! Sliced away! This was a full ball, outside off. Rajvardhan Hangargekar reaches out and slices it hard past the point fielder to fetch himself a boundary to end the innings. 23 runs off the last over and India Under-19 finish with 307/5.

SIX! DISPATCHED! Make it three in a row! Sherzad serves a juicy full toss this time, on off. Rajvardhan Hangargekar stays back and smokes it over the bowler's head for another maximum! 300 comes up for India Under-19!

SIX! BACK-TO-BACK SIXES! That is a phenomenal strike from Rajvardhan Hangargekar! Sherzad misses his mark yet again and serves a length ball, on middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar smacks it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum!

SIX! WOW! What a strike this is from Rajvardhan Hangargekar! He is playing a very handy knock at the back end for India Under-19! This was a full ball, around middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar stays back and whips it way over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Full ball, outside off. Dinesh Bana digs it out to the off side for a run.
Dinesh Bana comes out to bat now.

OUT! BOWLED! Muzamil Sherzad gets his third wicket and India Under-19 lose another one! This was a length ball, around middle. Kaushal Tambe shuffles across way too much in his crease and looks to whip it to the leg side. He misses it completely and the stumps are rattled.

Flatter ball, coming on with the angle from middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar backs away a bit and tries to slog hard but he misses and gets hit on his body. Rajvardhan Hangargekar looks to sneak in a bye but is sent back by his partner.
Swing and a miss! Flatter and quicker, outside off. Rajvardhan Hangargekar hangs back and throws his bat at it but fails to get any bat on it.
SIX! WHACKED! Tossed up, around middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar clears his front leg and sends it sailing way over the long on fence for a maximum!
Slight halt in play. Joshua Cox has been struck on the helmet. The physio is out there to check on him. He seems fine and we are good to resume!

DROPPED! A very tough chance though! This was a flatter and quicker ball, on a length, around off. Rajvardhan Hangargekar skips down to slog but it goes off the thick outside edge and hits the keeper on his helmet.
SIX! BOOM! Tossed up, on a length, around middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar shimmies down the track and goes big over long on to fetch himself a biggie.
Flatter ball, on middle. Kaushal Tambe nudges it to the leg side and collects a run.

Flatter ball, drifting onto the pads. Rajvardhan Hangargekar looks to heave it away but he misses and gets hit low on his pad.
Tossed up, around leg. Raj Angad Bawa tucks it to the leg side and takes off for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Oh, dear! The Indian captain would feel hard done by here! A wicket against the run of play and Ireland Under-19 are delighted! This was a length ball, angled down leg. Sindhu looks to flick but he only manages a slight tickle to the right of the keeper. Joshua Cox, behind the sticks takes an easy catch. India Under-19 lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Joshua Cox b Muzamil Sherzad

DRINKS! Ireland Under-19 have got the big wicket of Harnoor Singh and they would certainly breathe a bit easier now. The opening batters of India Under-19 have laid a brilliant foundation for the batters to follow and they are in a good position heading into the death overs. Ireland Under-19 would look to chip in with more wickets now and put the brakes on the scoring. Nishant Sindhu walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Jamie Forbes has been the pick of the Irish bowlers so far and he is rewarded now with a wicket of Angkrish Raghuvanshi. Forbes gets the much-needed breakthrough and India Under-19 lose their first wicket. This is a flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi stays back to cut but it goes off the thick outside edge towards the keeper. Joshua Cox behind the sticks, takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Joshua Cox b Jamie Forbes

DRINKS! India Under-19 certainly on top! They have dominated the innings so far. Harnoor Singh and Angkrish Raghuvanshi have put away all the bad deliveries and have not given any chance to the bowlers. Ireland Under-19 have not been at their best, they have failed to bowl tighter line, and length, which has resulted in India Under-19 cruising away. Also, Nathan McGuire (2-0-19-0) is back on!
Nicely tossed up, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi blocks it out solidly. A tidy over from Jamie Forbes. Just 2 runs off it.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi lunges forward to block this one.
Floated, on a length, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi tucks it to mid-wicket.
On a length, just outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi rocks back and defends it.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Harnoor Singh taps it towards backward point for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi stays back and punches it through the cover region for a run.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! This one was a short ball again, outside off. Harnoor Singh fetches this one from outside off and pulls it past mid on for a boundary.

FIVE WIDES! That brings up the 100 for India Under-19! A length ball, down the leg side. Harnoor Singh misses his flick, the keeper too fails to grab it, and the ball races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length, on the pads. Angkrish Raghuvanshi tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Much better from Liam Doherty! Full-length delivery, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Sloppy work! Fuller length delivery, outside off. Harnoor Singh drives it to the fielder at mid off, who fumbles and fails to grab the ball cleanly. A single taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. A singe taken.
Fuller ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh lunges and pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Turning it into the batter, on a fuller length. Harnoor Singh tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike for the next over.
Quicker this time, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi stays back and pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
Touch shorter, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi blocks it out on the off side.
Short, wide of off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi chops it towards cover. Dot ball.
Loopy ball, outside off. Blocked out.
Jamie Forbes comes to bowl.
Jamie Forbes starts off with a flatter ball, around the pads. Harnoor Singh nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Very full, around middle. Harnoor Singh looks to tonk this but miscues his shot back to the bowler.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Liam Doherty misses his length, serves a low full toss ball. Harnoor Singh whips this towards wide of long on for a boundary. No ball called for overstepping and a free hit to follow.
Outside off, on a length. Angkrish Raghuvanshi taps it towards point for a single.
Change of angle this time. Liam Doherty goes 'round the wicket, serves a full ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh leans and drives. But gets an outside edge towards mid-wicket for a single.
Very full, outside off. Harnoor Singh drags it to the fielder at mid on.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Harnoor Singh jabs it out back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Harnoor Singh shoulders his arms at it.
Fuller ball, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi leans and nudges it towards mid-wicket. Dot to end the over.

SIX! BOOM! Another short ball and Angkrish Raghuvanshi is not going to miss out on these. He brings up his fifty in style! Back of a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi swivels and pulls this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Brilliant stuff!
Touch fuller, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi leans and blocks it out.
Another shorter ball, on the pads. Harnoor Singh pushes it towards square leg for a single.

Excellent fielding! A short ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh pulls this towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder from deep mid-wicket runs to his left and puts in a dive to stop the ball from crossing the ropes. Two runs taken.
Slower through the air, on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi covers his stumps and taps it towards square leg for a quick single.
Full and outside off. Harnoor Singh lunges and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, again on the pads. Harnoor Singh flicks it to mid-wicket. No run there.
FOUR! Perfect timing on that! A length ball, shaping in on the pads. Harnoor Singh clips it uppishly towards deep square leg for a boundary.
On a length, around the pads. Harnoor Singh flicks it to mid-wicket.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Slower ball, darting it on the pads, on a full length. Angkrish Raghuvanshi taps it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Flatter ball, around middle. Harnoor Singh tucks it to the leg side. India Under-19 are 68/0 at the end of the Powerplay 1.
This is on a length, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi eases it down to long on and gives the strike back to Harnoor Singh.
Tossed up, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Punished by Angkrish Raghuvanshi! Humphreys hurls a half-tracker, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi rocks back and pulls it in front of square to fetch himself a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Angkrish Raghuvanshi goes big! Tossed up, on a length, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi skips down a bit and lofts it over the long on region for a biggie.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi taps it towards backward point.
Matthew Humphreys (2-0-13-0) is back into the attack.
This is a yorker-length ball, around middle. Harnoor Singh digs it out watchfully.
FOUR! Too straight from Doherty and it gets the treatment! Full ball, around middle. Harnoor Singh flicks it through the mid-wicket region and collects another boundary.
Doherty drags his length back a bit and serves a good-length ball, around middle. Harnoor Singh turns it to mid-wicket.
On a length, angling in from middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Lovely stroke but just the single. Fuller in length, outside off. Harnoor Singh lunges forward and drives it straight to the deep cover fielder.
Length ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh drives it to the cover fielder.
Into the blockhole, around middle. Harnoor Singh squeezes it out to the leg side for a run.
Liam Doherty comes into the attack.
Wide! Length ball, sprayed down the leg side. Harnoor Singh misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Short of a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi rocks back and punches it through the cover region for a single.
A yorker-length delivery, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi skips down and digs it out.
Length ball, angling in from off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi covers the line of the ball and turns it to mid-wicket.
Sherzad goes a bit fuller this time, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi blocks it off the front foot.
Good-length ball, around leg. Harnoor Singh tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi cuts it but finds the cover fielder.
On a length, around middle and leg. Angkrish Raghuvanshi tucks it to mid-wicket.
Good running from India Under-19 openers! Flatter ball, around leg. Harnoor Singh tucks it to the leg side and scampers through to the other end.
Flatter ball, on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi clips it towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi lunges forward and drives it through the mid off region. The fielder there gives it a chase but the ball wins.
Loopy ball, around leg. Angkrish Raghuvanshi looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
Back of a length, just outside off. Harnoor Singh defends it to the off side off the front foot.
On a length, around off. Harnoor Singh blocks it out.

FOUR! AND AGAIN! Two in two for Singh! Such lovely timing from the southpaw! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Harnoor Singh lunges forward and nudges it through the mid-wicket region. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Nonchalance! Length ball, around middle. Harnoor Singh prods and flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length, around leg. Harnoor Singh hangs back and defends it out.
Good-length ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh leaves it alone.
Tossed up delivery, full and on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi lunges and blocks it out. 13 runs off Nathan McGuire's first over!

FOUR! Third of the over! This has been punished! Nathan McGuire drops it short again, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi, once again, pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Not good stuff this from Ireland Under-19!
Loopy ball, on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi defends it out.
FOUR! Glorious! Much fuller this time, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi presses forward and drives it beautifully through cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Shot! Another spinner but the same result! Nathan McGuire drops it short this time, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi swivels and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Nathan McGuire starts with a loopy ball, full, around middle. Harnoor Singh leans and taps it towards square leg for a quick single.
Nathan McGuire comes to bowl.
Yorker-length ball, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi opens the face of his bat and jabs it out towards point.
On a length, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi walks across the off stump and defends it out.
Full-length ball, down the leg side. Angkrish Raghuvanshi misses his flick once again, but no wide called this time.
Another fuller ball, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi blocks it towards extra cover.
WIDE! Touch fuller, spraying it down the leg side. Angkrish Raghuvanshi misses his flick and a wide is called.
Fuller, around middle and leg. Angkrish Raghuvanshi leans and blocks it out solidy.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Harnoor Singh nudges it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. A single taken.
Fuller, on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi pushes it back to the bowler. Expensive over this for Ireland Under-19.
FOUR! More runs for India Under-19! Another full ball, spraying it down the leg side. Angkrish Raghuvanshi leans and tickles it towards the fine leg fence for the third boundary of the over.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A loopy ball, full in length and down the leg side this time. Angkrish Raghuvanshi sweeps this past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! A loose delivery by Matthew Humphreys! Outside off, touch shorter. Angkrish Raghuvanshi stays back and slashes that past point for a cracking boundary.
Slower through the air, around the off pole. Angkrish Raghuvanshi, on the back foot, taps it towards point. No run there.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi presses forward and blocks it towards point.
On a length, outside off. Harnoor Singh hangs back and defends it back to the bowler. 5 runs off Muzamil Sherzad's first over.
Muzamil Sherzad serves a full ball, outside off. Harnoor Singh watches it sail through to the keeper.
Another full-length delivery, outside off. Harnoor Singh drives it to the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A fuller ball, around middle. Harnoor Singh uses his wrists and flicks it beautifully past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Touch shorter again, around off, little away movement here for Muzamil Sherzad. Harnoor Singh covers his line and blocks it out solidly.
Muzamil Sherzad begins with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi shuffles across and taps it to mid-wicket for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Muzamil Sherzad.
Quicker this time, outside off. Harnoor Singh leaves it alone. Just 1 run off the first over!
India and Angkrish Raghuvanshi are up and running! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi drives it to long off and takes a single.
Floated delivery, around off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi leans and defends it out.
Loopy ball, around middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi drives it to mid on.
Fuller this time, tosses it up, Angkrish Raghuvanshi prods and blocks it out watchfully.
Matthew Humphreys starts off with a flat ball, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi hangs back and cuts it to the fielder at cover.

We are done with all the pre-match formalities and it is time for live action! Ireland Under-19 team are in a huddle before they spread out on the field. Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Harnoor Singh walk out to open the batting for India Under-19. Matthew Humphreys will start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
Right then! The players of both the teams are lined up for their respective national anthems. First, it will be the anthem of Ireland, followed by the anthem of India.

PITCH REPORT - Samuel Badree is near the pitch. He says that the pitch is quite firm, a lot of dry grass and has less moisture. But, it is a batting-friendly wicket. Adds that there will be some early assistance for the fast bowlers but then the batters will enjoy themselves.

Nishant Sindhu, the skipper of India Under-19, says that they have won the previous game and they will try to carry the same momentum going forward. On being asked what would they have done if they won the toss, he says they would have batted first. Concludes by saying that they have two changes to their side.

Tim Tector, the skipper of Ireland Under-19, says they will bowl first. Adds that the pitch looks a bit moist and they will look to exploit these conditions. Tells that this pitch looks better than the previous game and looks like a good one to bat on. Informs that they are unchanged going into this game.

India Under-19 (Playing XI) - Harnoor Singh, Angkrish Raghuvanshi, Raj Angad Bawa, Nishant Sindhu (C), Kaushal Tambe, Dinesh Bana (WK), Garv Sangwan (In for Yash Dhull), Vicky Ostwal, Aneeshwar Gautam (In for Shaik Rasheed), Rajvardhan Hangargekar, Ravi Kumar.

Ireland Under-19 (Unchanged Playing XI) - David Vincent, Liam Doherty, Jack Dickson, Joshua Cox (WK), Tim Tector (C), Philippus le Roux, Nathan McGuire, Scott MacBeth, Matthew Humphreys, Jamie Forbes, Muzamil Sherzad.
TOSS - Ireland Under-19 have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of yet another exciting clash of the Under-19 World Cup 2022. Game number 15 sees a group B clash between two unbeaten sides, Ireland and India. India U-19 are coming into this contest at the back of a solid win against South Africa U-19, while Ireland U-19 are coming into this contest having won their previous fixture against Uganda U-19. Both these sides have some seriously talented players in their unit and they will be eager to keep on with the winning momentum. It will be interesting to see which side comes out on top and stays unbeaten in the competition. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
